component.name: Radiant
component.summary: Private music player for your local audio files

description.p: Radiant plays the music stored on your computer. No ads, no accounts, no tracking: the network is used only for the optional Dropbox download and for downloading the AI model.

ul.li: MP3, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AAC, ALAC and WAV with accurate seeking and a Hi-Res / Lossless badge
12-band equalizer, presets, bass, treble, normalization and pitch-preserving speed from 0.5x to 3x
Albums, playlists and four queues, synced lyrics and a spectrum visualizer
Optional AI stem separation (vocals, drums, bass, other)
App lock with a code and a recovery phrase
